title: Content of JSON type null

source.note: composed: Annex A types Content as ["string", "number", "object", "array", "boolean", "null"]; this case pins the null member. The format is `generic` so that no rule of §5.3 constrains the content's shape and the case is about the decoder alone.

notes: Annex A allows Content to be null, so a null decodes to a null value rather than to a missing field. Under `text` or `token` the same value is an Error from validate — see readings/33-content-null-text.
